purpose: Fixed raw-scan review regions selected before the V5 result run. The names describe review hypotheses, not ground truth or expected labels.

source.selectionEvidence: LAS header plus a deterministic 1/47 raw-point scatter sampled before V5 execution. The sample shows a long rectangular assembly from x about 2.0–6.6 and y about -2.6–-0.85, repeated horizontal/vertical structure, and elevated/end geometry.

regions.explanation: Whole scan context; use to detect broad spatial drift or unexpected global class coverage.
Central repeated grid visible in the raw top-view sample; review planar bar separation without asserting each line is a bar.
Low, left/lower boundary of the raw assembly; checks whether a support-surface edge stays observed rather than filled.
Left-end elevated/post-like raw geometry adjacent to the grid; fixture candidate only, selected from raw elevation and footprint.
Right-end dense/turning-looking raw structure; a hook or termination candidate, not an asserted hook.
Central elevated crossing/vertical-looking support in the raw side scatter; review web-candidate orientation.
Central-right region where raw top-view bands overlap while the side view spans several heights; review layer/instance ambiguity.
